title: Kollektiv label taxonomy
description: The suite's single source of truth for issue labels, on both sides of the sync: GitHub labels applied by scripts/sync-labels.sh, and their Linear counterparts created by hand or by /suite-kit:suite-sync. Never add a label directly in a repo or in Linear — add it here and propagate it, for the same reason design/tokens.json is not edited from a product.

name.description: Lowercase, optionally 'category:value'. No spaces — GitHub label names are free text but the suite's own vocabulary is not.

color.description: Lowercase six-digit hex, no leading '#' — the shape the GitHub labels API expects.
Six-digit hex with leading '#' — the shape Linear's own labels already use.

version.description: Bump only on a breaking shape change.

github.description: The label set scripts/sync-labels.sh applies to every repo in suite.repos.json plus this one. Flat and repo-agnostic — the same fifteen labels exist everywhere, so an issue's meaning does not depend on which repo it lives in.

linear.description: Linear labels created once per workspace, not per team. 'repo' exists only here — GitHub issues don't need to say which repo they're in.

repo.description: One per repo in suite.repos.json plus kollektiv itself, so a cross-team Linear view can still filter to one repo.

type.description: Mirrors github[].name entries prefixed 'type:', plus any label the workspace already had before this taxonomy (e.g. Improvement) that is kept as a legacy alias rather than deleted.

area.description: Mirrors github[].name entries prefixed 'area:', same colors, so the two sides read as one system.

flags.description: Labels with no GitHub equivalent, or whose meaning is Linear-side only (e.g. source:github marking a routine-created issue).
